lines.text: The temporal adverbs“在/正在”are placed before a verb,expressing that an action is
ongoing or a situation is continuing. This lesson introduces two forms: (1) 在/正在+Verb;
(2)在/正在+Verb+呢. Additionally,there is a third form to express an ongoing action:(3) Verb+
呢.For negative responses, the adverb “没(有)” is used.
